title: ceropegia maccoyiana
intro: Ceropegia maccoyiana, commonly known as the rope vine or ceropegia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is known for its unique, rope-like tendrils and its potential medicinal properties. The health benefits of Ceropegia maccoyiana include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues.
